english: This closes the bag without billing. Tell us why — it's recorded on the order.
arabic: يغلق هذا الحقيبة دون فوترة. أخبرنا لماذا — يُسجَّل على الطلب.

key: This module is off, so its apps are hidden for everyone. Settings are kept for when you switch it back on.
english: This module is off, so its apps are hidden for everyone. Settings are kept for when you switch it back on.

key: This posts tonight's room and tax for every in-house guest, applies the no-show policy, saves the audit pack and rolls the business date from {bd}. It cannot be undone.
english: This posts tonight's room and tax for every in-house guest, applies the no-show policy, saves the audit pack and rolls the business date from {bd}. It cannot be undone.
arabic: يرحّل هذا غرفة وضريبة الليلة لكل نزيل مقيم، ويطبّق سياسة عدم الحضور، ويحفظ حزمة التدقيق وينقل تاريخ العمل من {bd}. لا يمكن التراجع عنه.

key: This type is full tonight - try another room type.
english: This type is full tonight - try another room type.
arabic: هذا النوع ممتلئ الليلة - جرّب نوع غرفة آخر.

key: Tick the lines moving to the new bill.
english: Tick the lines moving to the new bill.
arabic: حدد البنود المنقولة إلى الفاتورة الجديدة.

key: Times drive the house position: back-to-back rooms flag a conflict when the arrival lands before the departure.
english: Times drive the house position: back-to-back rooms flag a conflict when the arrival lands before the departure.
arabic: الأوقات تحدد موقع الفندق: الغرف المتتالية تعلّم تعارضاً عندما يصل الضيف قبل مغادرة السابق.

key: Today at this property, by department.
english: Today at this property, by department.
arabic: اليوم في هذا العقار، حسب القسم.

key: Undo — put it back on the board
english: Undo — put it back on the board

key: Unit / room numbers per listing, comma-separated.
english: Unit / room numbers per listing, comma-separated.
arabic: أرقام الوحدات / الغرف لكل قائمة، مفصولة بفواصل.

key: Want Claude the model in this chat? Use the OpenRouter preset.
english: Want Claude the model in this chat? Use the OpenRouter preset.

key: We already have this from your last visit — we'll use it. Add a photo below only to replace it with a newer one.
english: We already have this from your last visit — we'll use it. Add a photo below only to replace it with a newer one.
arabic: لدينا هذا من زيارتك السابقة وسنستخدمه. أضف صورة أدناه فقط لاستبداله بنسخة أحدث.

key: What is it? (Staff uniforms, Pool towels…)
english: What is it? (Staff uniforms, Pool towels…)

key: What this money is: against the bill, an advance, or a refundable deposit
english: What this money is: against the bill, an advance, or a refundable deposit
arabic: ما هذا المال: مقابل الفاتورة، أو مقدمة، أو تأمين قابل للاسترداد

key: When off, phone and ID numbers in tool results are shortened to the last four digits before they leave Kamra.
english: When off, phone and ID numbers in tool results are shortened to the last four digits before they leave Kamra.

key: When the guest pays, the deposit posts here automatically.
english: When the guest pays, the deposit posts here automatically.
arabic: عند دفع النزيل، يُسجَّل العربون هنا تلقائيًا.

key: Which hall - free for these dates and hours
english: Which hall - free for these dates and hours
arabic: أي قاعة - متاحة لهذه التواريخ والساعات

key: Which system is this export from?
english: Which system is this export from?

arabic: البريد الإلكتروني أو اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.

key: You can't change your own access
english: You can't change your own access

key: Your details and signature form the guest register required by law.
english: Your details and signature form the guest register required by law.
arabic: تشكّل بياناتك وتوقيعك سجل النزلاء المطلوب نظامًا.

key: Your ID photo is kept with the guest register the hotel is required by law to maintain. Only hotel staff can see it.
english: Your ID photo is kept with the guest register the hotel is required by law to maintain. Only hotel staff can see it.
arabic: تُحفظ صورة هويتك مع سجل النزلاء الذي يلتزم الفندق نظامًا بالاحتفاظ به. لا يطّلع عليها إلا موظفو الفندق.

key: Your ID photo is used only to confirm your identity at arrival, and is permanently deleted when you check out. Only hotel staff can see it.
english: Your ID photo is used only to confirm your identity at arrival, and is permanently deleted when you check out. Only hotel staff can see it.
arabic: تُستخدم صورة هويتك فقط للتحقق من هويتك عند الوصول، وتُحذف نهائيًا عند المغادرة. لا يطّلع عليها إلا موظفو الفندق.

key: your name and contact details to make and manage this booking and reach you about it
english: your name and contact details to make and manage this booking and reach you about it
arabic: اسمك وبيانات التواصل لإجراء هذا الحجز وإدارته والتواصل معك بشأنه

key: Your profile is erased {months} months after your last stay. Bills are kept as tax law requires.
english: Your profile is erased {months} months after your last stay. Bills are kept as tax law requires.
arabic: يُحذف ملفك بعد {months} شهرًا من آخر إقامة. وتُحفظ الفواتير وفق ما يتطلبه النظام الضريبي.

key: Your profile is kept for future stays until you ask for it to be erased. Bills are kept as tax law requires.
english: Your profile is kept for future stays until you ask for it to be erased. Bills are kept as tax law requires.
arabic: يُحفظ ملفك لإقاماتك القادمة حتى تطلب حذفه. وتُحفظ الفواتير وفق ما يتطلبه النظام الضريبي.

key: Your role has no settings to manage.
english: Your role has no settings to manage.

key: Your session ended. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
english: Your session ended. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
arabic: انتهت جلستك. سجّل الدخول للمتابعة من حيث توقفت.

key: ZATCA Phase 1 ready - QR and XML on every invoice.
english: ZATCA Phase 1 ready - QR and XML on every invoice.
arabic: جاهز للمرحلة الأولى من زاتكا - رمز QR وملف XML على كل فاتورة.

key: ZATCA: still needed for valid e-invoices - {fields}.
english: ZATCA: still needed for valid e-invoices - {fields}.
arabic: زاتكا: مطلوب لإصدار فواتير إلكترونية صحيحة - {fields}.
